text:
incident-bot: Alert — p99 latency spike for /v1/generate (eu-west). p95 800ms -> 1.8s, p99 1.2s -> 4.5s. SLO burn ~18% over last 5m. PagerDuty incident PDINC-9842 opened and auto-page fired.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PDINC-9842 assigned to maria (oncall) — please ack to stop auto-escalation.
maria: Acked. I'm on it. Good catch. Any recent deploys in eu-west?
jon: No deploys in last 30m. Telemetry: batch size on hot path increased, KV cache miss rate up ~4x. Also a traffic spike from partner-integ.
lee: Checking autoscaler — dedicated-eu-1 nodes are saturated, seeing preemptions. Trying to scale but cloud quota errors showing. Opening support ticket.
tasha: Customer-fx: some customers report UI timeouts on embeddings/long-gen. Not many 5xx, mostly timeouts/very high latency.
maria: Mitigation plan: 1) divert non-critical traffic to fallback model redwood-compact-v1; 2) reduce batch size for /v1/generate to 8; 3) trigger KV warmup. Implementing 1+2 now.
lee: Applied routing change: divert tag=low-priority to redwood-compact-v1 in eu-west.
jon: Reduced batcher max size in runtime config — applied patch: `PATCH /config/batcher { "max_batch": 8 }` — changes live.
tasha: Starting KV warmup to refill prefix cache.
tasha: ```bash
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s 'https://internal-api/eu-west/warm?model=redwood-v1' >/dev/null; done
```
lee: Autoscaler request submitted to cloud (+2 GPUs to dedicated-eu-1). Support ticket #CLD-5983, ETA ~6m.
maria: Observability: p99 down to ~1.9s after divert + warmup. SLO burn ~4% now. Keeping PD open for 30m. Handing off to lee for capacity followup and escalation if scaling fails. @lee you own until resolved.
lee: Ack. I'll monitor capacity and escalate if scaling doesn't finish in +10m. Plan B: reroute more traffic to fallback and consider rollback of any risky config changes.
pagerduty-bot: PDINC-9842 status update: acknowledged by maria, on-call owner lee (handoff).
maria: Handoff summary: suspected root cause = KV cache cold + batcher-induced hotpath overload. Mitigations applied = traffic divert to compact model, batch size cap, KV warmup, autoscaler request. Customer impact = intermittent UI timeouts for subset of customers for ~15-25m, low 5xx. Followups: confirm autoscaler + consider permanent batcher cap for eu-west and add KV warmup during rolling autoscaler events.
